name: Lanthalerhof
beschreibung: The Lanthalerhof welcomes travelers to the historic market town of Matrei am Brenner in Tyrol's scenic Wipptal Valley. This family-operated farmstead offers comfortable guest rooms and holiday apartments decorated with traditional alpine woodwork and private balconies with mountain views. Surrounded by peaceful meadows and pine woods, it provides a restorative rural retreat. Its convenient setting along the Brenner route makes it ideal for overnight stopovers and extended holidays alike. In winter, nearby ski resorts like Bergeralm and Serlesbahnen are reached within minutes, while summer invites alpine hikes to traditional mountain pastures.
kurzbeschreibung: Charming alpine farmstead and holiday apartments in Matrei am Brenner in the Wipptal Valley.
